author: Marie Paiser
content: The support from Dancing Cubs for our event was brilliant. The service pre-event was efficient and responsive and really helpful - there are loads of different options and packages to make sure you get exactly what you need. The service on the day was equally efficient with the delivery guy going above and beyond to get it all set out and packed away again. The play park went down so well with all the kids - will definitely be using Dancing Cubs again!
